triggers: a kernel on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120) risks the '6. Forcing b12x tactics without runtime-M safety' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 6. Forcing b12x tactics without runtime-M safety

problem.statement: SM120 NVFP4 Decode GEMM Production Pitfalls -- 6. Forcing b12x tactics without runtime-M safety

payload.attempted: A forced b12x tactic gives a small win for one short-M bucket, so route all matching `N,K` gate/up shapes through it.
payload.lesson: If the router cannot express the exact safe predicate, do not promote the tactic. Tiny per-layer operator savings are not worth a broad served-risk surface.

established_fact.mechanism: An N/K-only guard is too broad for a tactic whose benefit depends on runtime M.

payload.observed: Other M buckets regress, and vLLM compile mode may not safely branch on exact symbolic runtime `M`.
payload.root_cause: An N/K-only guard is too broad for a tactic whose benefit depends on runtime M.
